name: sincrohub
description: Integrated operations and monitoring hub for telemetry, incidents and automation.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sincrohub/contracts && npm run build -w @sincrohub/api && npm run build -w @sincrohub/gateway && npm run build -w @sincrohub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sincrohub/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
